bio-evo-01-c1.text: The Linnean Society of London (2018). 1st July 2018: 160th anniversary of the presentation of "On the tendency of Species to form Varieties". Linnean Society of London.
bio-evo-01-c1.quote: Unfortunately, neither of the two were present.
bio-evo-01-c1.claim: Lyell and Hooker arranged for both men's papers to be read together at the Linnean Society on 1 July 1858, and neither author attended.
